description: Reference work unit: redshift-binned galaxy statistics on one OpenUniverse2024 HEALPix tile. Predicate selects ~rg0 only (redshift zone maps prune rg1-rg3); kernel touches 3 of 18 columns.

kernel.sql: SELECT CAST(FLOOR(redshift / 0.05) AS INTEGER) AS z_bin, COUNT(*) AS n_gal, MIN(ra) AS ra_min, MAX(ra) AS ra_max, MIN(dec) AS dec_min, MAX(dec) AS dec_max, SUM(redshift) AS z_sum, AVG(redshift) AS z_mean FROM read_parquet('$RSS_DATASET_URL') WHERE redshift < 0.5 GROUP BY z_bin ORDER BY z_bin

slice.expected_row_groups: 1 of 4 (rg0; rg1-rg3 pruned by redshift column statistics)

output.canonicalization: rss-canon-v0 (rows sorted by canonical serialization; sorted JSON keys; no whitespace; doubles as fixed 6-decimal strings, -0 normalized, NaN/Infinity as strings; int64 as JSON number when |v| <= 2^53-1 else decimal string)
